question:
**Direction: Identify from the following options the word which is OPPOSITE in meaning to the given word.**

Opaque
solution:
The correct answer is "**Transparent**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us explore the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Opaque" **means not able to be seen through, not transparent or translucent.(निष्प्रभ)

 
 
• **Example**: *The bottles were filled with a pale **opaque**__ liquid.*
 
 
 
• **"Transparent" **means something that you can see through. (पारदर्शी)
 __
 
• **​Example**: *The glass is **transparent**__.*
 
 
 
 
 
• ​​Thus, it is clear that the word **"transparent"** is the antonym of the word **"opaque."**
 
• ​Hence, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Intangible" **means unable to be touched or grasped; not having physical presence.(अमूर्त)
 
• **"Shadowy"** means full of shadows; dimly lit or obscure.(छायादार)
 
• **"Reflector" **means a surface or object that reflects light, sound, or heat.(परावर्तक)
